title: An elementary obstruction to same-ground-set matroid-rank approximation
accepted_scope: No single dimension-independent alpha approximates every normalized nonnegative monotone submodular function by an ordinary matroid rank on same ground set; sqrt-cardinality forces alpha>=n^(1/6), rational family n^(1/4)/sqrt2.
limitations: No gap asserted for explicitly quantified literal theorem; relation to any alternative intended formulation must be reconciled.
